info.name: Email Security Scorer API
info.description:
All endpoints for the Upwind Email Security Scorer backend.

Set the collection variables before running:
- `baseUrl`  — your Vercel deployment URL (e.g. https://your-project.vercel.app) or ngrok tunnel for local dev
- `apiSecret` — the value of ADDON_API_SECRET (same secret set in Vercel env vars and Apps Script Script Properties)

Endpoints:
  GET  /api/health   — liveness check, no auth required
  POST /api/analyze  — full email analysis, Bearer token required

variable.description: Base URL of the backend. Use your Vercel production URL or ngrok tunnel for local dev (e.g. https://a1b2c3d4.ngrok-free.app).
Value of ADDON_API_SECRET. Must match what is set in Vercel environment variables.

request.description: Liveness check. No authentication required. Returns backend version and the list of active scanners.

item.name: Phishing — Google Docs impersonation (DMARC fail + typosquat)

request.description:
Classic credential-harvesting phish: typosquatted Google domain (goog1e.com), DMARC fail, asks victim to enter username and password.

Expected: score 70–90, riskLevel CRITICAL.

item.name: BEC — CEO wire transfer fraud (no URLs, pure linguistics)

request.description:
Business Email Compromise: CEO impersonation requesting an urgent wire transfer. No URLs or attachments — purely linguistic attack that evades signature-based filters.

Expected: score 60–85, riskLevel HIGH or CRITICAL. BECLinguisticScanner should dominate.

item.name: BEC — Gift card request (feature starvation pattern)

request.description:
BEC feature starvation: extremely short email with financial intent, deliberately minimizes detectable signals. Classic gift-card BEC pattern.

Expected: score 40–70. BECLinguisticScanner FEATURE_STARVATION_BEC signal should fire.

item.name: Phishing — Fake Okta SSO with dangerous attachment

request.description:
Multi-vector attack: DMARC fail + urgency language + fake Okta domain + double-extension attachment (.pdf.exe).

Expected: score 80–100, riskLevel CRITICAL. Multiple scanners should fire.

Clean legitimate email: real Google Calendar invite, all auth passes, no suspicious language or URLs.
